historical_commentary.text: B-tree indexing is a fundamental database concept that remains relevant today. 4D still uses B-tree indexes, though modern versions have added composite indexes, full-text indexes, and other index types. The theoretical discussion of B-tree structure and advantages would still be largely accurate, making this note of lasting educational value despite the specific 4D v6 context.
related_updates: 4D has added composite indexes, keyword indexes, and other index types beyond basic B-tree
Index management UI and commands have evolved but B-tree fundamentals remain the same
